_comment: Module 6 crawl targets. Add public hospital/clinic 'Our Doctors' roster pages here. 'wait_for' is the CSS selector to wait for on JS-rendered pages — without it the crawler extracts an empty shell and reports 0 doctors for a page that has plenty.
_rules: Only public pages. Never a page behind a login, and never one whose robots.txt disallows crawling.
The ingest API enforces clinic opt-outs; do not try to filter them here.
city/state are fallbacks used only when the page itself does not state them.
TARGETS ABHI KHAALI HAI — real hospital 'Our Doctors' URL daalne par crawler turant kaam karega (cron weekly chalega).
